# glinet_samba_share (Resource)

Manage one Samba share section read by the stock `/etc/init.d/samba4`. Values such as `read_only` are passed to smb.conf unchanged, so use `yes` or `no`.

## Import existing configuration

Use an initialized project from [Check the router](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/elephant-evergreen/glinet/latest/docs#check-the-router). Add this import block with your resource address and the existing object’s ID.

```terraform
import {
  to = glinet_samba_share.media
  id = "media_share"
}
```

1. Add the example’s resource block with the values already on the router.
2. Run `terraform plan -out=adopt.tfplan` and keep a plan that contains only the import. If it proposes changes, match the differing arguments to the router and save a new plan.
3. Apply the saved plan.

If you are unsure what values to use, [generate a draft from the existing object](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import/generating-configuration). Keep the import block, omit the resource block, and run `terraform plan -generate-config-out=generated.tf`. Review the draft before preparing the saved import plan.

## Example configuration

```terraform
resource "glinet_samba_share" "media" {
  section         = "media_share"
  share_name      = "media"
  path            = "/mnt/media"
  read_only       = "yes"
  guest_ok        = "no"
  delete_behavior = "delete"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) Shared directory.
- `section` (String) UCI section name.
- `share_name` (String) Share name shown to clients.

### Optional

- `browseable` (String) `yes` or `no`.
- `create_mask` (String) Create mask, such as `0666`.
- `delete_behavior` (String) Destroy behavior. `forget` releases Terraform ownership and preserves the UCI section; `delete` removes a Terraform-created named section. Firmware-owned anonymous sections are always preserved.
- `dir_mask` (String) Directory mask, such as `0777`.
- `force_root` (Boolean) Force file access as root.
- `guest_ok` (String) `yes` or `no`.
- `guest_only` (String) `yes` or `no`.
- `inherit_owner` (String) `yes` or `no`.
- `read_list` (String) Space-separated users with read-only access.
- `read_only` (String) `yes` or `no`.
- `timemachine` (Boolean) Advertise the share as a Time Machine target.
- `timemachine_maxsize` (String) Time Machine quota in gigabytes.
- `users` (String) Space-separated valid users.
- `vfs_objects` (String) Space-separated VFS modules.
- `write_list` (String) Space-separated users with write access.
- `writeable` (String) `yes` or `no`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable import identifier.
- `owner` (String) Owner token recorded with the router section. It detects another Terraform state that manages the same section.
- `uci_section` (String) Resolved UCI section name on the router.
